skills.name: videodraft
skills.description: Create AI videos, images, Seed Audio, voiceovers, music, sound effects, dialogue, dubbing, storyboards, avatar videos, media upscales and product/ad videos with VideoDraft. Use when the user mentions VideoDraft, or asks to generate/make a video, video ad, explainer, storyboard, talking-head/avatar video, AI image, prompt-driven or reference-driven audio, voiceover/TTS, background music, sound effects, dialogue audio, voice changing, dubbing, or image/video enhancement and upscaling, including batch/programmatic video generation in scripts or CI. Works via the `videodraft` CLI (preferred in terminals) or the VideoDraft MCP connector.
